What is the approximate percentage increase in the production of sugar from sugarcane in the state of UP in the year 2018 as compared to 2017?
solution:
**Calculation:**

According to the question,

The production of sugar from sugarcane in the state of UP in the year 2018 as compared to 2017

Increase in Percentage = (7 - 6.2)/6.2

⇒ 0.1290

In percentage = 0.1290 × 100

⇒ 13% Approx. 

**∴ The approximate percentage increase in the production of sugar from sugarcane in the state of UP in the year 2018 as compared to 2017 is 13%.**
